name: Grant Business Manager module access
description: Open Administration → Organization → Roles, select the merchant role, and enable the B2C Migration module and menu actions for this site.

name: Confirm cartridge paths
description: Verify the Business Manager site cartridge path includes bm_accelerator and the storefront site path includes app_custom_cms (plus modules if you use SFRA controllers).

name: Configure site preferences
description: Open Merchant Tools → Site Preferences → Custom Preferences → B2C Migration Console and enter source-platform, OCAPI, Amplience, and optional OpenAI values. Do not put production secrets in IMPEX.

name: Configure service credentials
description: Open Administration → Operations → Services and confirm accelerator.* services exist. Runtime code sets URLs per call; leave placeholder credentials unless your instance requires them.

name: Test source connection
description: Open Merchant Tools → B2C Migration → Start Migration Wizard and run Test Connection for commercetools, Shopify, BigCommerce, or SAP.

name: Optional Amplience storefront extension
description: If this instance uses Storefront Next with GitHub connected, merge the Commerce App storefront PR. Otherwise run b2c cap pull and copy storefront-next/ into the merchant sfnext app. The gallery calls AmplienceContent-List on the storefront site.
